ContactsNewContactDialog.description: Add a person to your contacts. These contacts will be shared with all users of this organization.
ContactsNewContactDialog.businessCardDescription: Scan or upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image, then review every detail. Automatic reading runs on this Connex instance when available; otherwise, the metadata-free image may be sent to your organization's configured AI provider. A metadata-free copy is saved with the contact when you create it.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardScanReady: Details added. Review them before creating the contact.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardManualFallback: Scanning stopped. Keep the image and enter the details manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardManualOnly: Automatic reading isn't available. Keep the image and enter the details manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardSelectionUnsupported: Choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image. The current selection, if any, was kept.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardWarningLowConfidence: Some details have low confidence. Review them carefully.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardWarningPartial: Only part of the card was recognized. Enter any missing details.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardWarningOrientation: The card angle made some details harder to read.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardWarningNoFields: No contact details were recognized. Enter them manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardWarningAiProvider: Your organization's configured AI provider read this image. Review every recognized detail.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorUnauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again before scanning this card.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorForbidden: You don't have permission to scan or import this card.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorTooLarge: This image is too large. Choose a smaller image.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorUnsupportedType: Choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorUnreadable: The card could not be read. Keep the image and enter the details manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorBusy: Card scanning is busy. Try again in a moment.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorTimeout: Scanning took too long. Try again or enter the details manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorUnavailable: Card scanning is unavailable. You can still enter the details manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorRejected: This card could not be scanned. You can enter the details manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardErrorFailed: The card could not be scanned. Try again or enter the details manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorUnauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again, then create the contact.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorForbidden: You don't have permission to retain this card image.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorTooLarge: This card image is too large to retain. Choose a smaller image or continue without retaining it.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorTooLargeRequired: This card image is too large to retain with the new company. Choose a smaller image and try again.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorImage: This card image can't be retained. Choose another image or continue without retaining it.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorImageRequired: This card image can't be retained with the new company. Choose another JPEG, PNG, or WebP image and try again.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorBusy: Card import is busy. Try creating the contact again in a moment.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorConflict: The import outcome could not be matched safely. Keep the reviewed details unchanged and try again.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorUnavailable: The import outcome is uncertain. Keep the reviewed details unchanged and try again to safely confirm whether the contact was created.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorRecoveryStorage: This browser could not safely retain a recovery key, so Connex did not start the card import. Check browser storage settings and try again.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorRejected: The card could not be imported with these details. Review the highlighted fields and try again.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportErrorFailed: The import outcome is uncertain. Keep the reviewed details unchanged and try again to safely confirm whether the contact was created.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportRecoveryFailed: Connex could not safely check an earlier card import. Check your contacts before recreating that card. You can still create a different contact manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportRecoveryStorageUnavailable: Business-card import is off because this browser cannot safely store a recovery key. You can still create a contact manually.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportRecovered: The contact from your earlier card import was created.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportRecoveryGone: Connex can no longer confirm an earlier card request. Check your contacts before retrying that card.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardImportRecoveredAvatarPending: The earlier contact was created, but the selected profile photo was not uploaded. Open the contact and choose the photo again.
ContactsNewContactDialog.cardAvatarUploadFailed: Contact created, but the profile photo could not be added.

ContactRestrictions.description: APPI cease-of-use controls for {name}. Restricted contacts stay visible for management but stop being processed.
ContactRestrictions.suspendHint: Stops scoring, automation, suggestions, AI features, and exports for this contact.
ContactRestrictions.provisionHint: Blocks new workspace shares and excludes this contact from AI provider calls.
ContactRestrictions.provisionWarning: Saving revokes every existing workspace share of this contact immediately.
